name: SentinelOne: disconnect agent from network
description: Run from a case: find the SentinelOne agent whose computer name is the case's host and send 'disconnect from network' to that agent only, then record both HTTP statuses in a case note.

params.label: SentinelOne console host
params.help: Your management console host name, as in the browser address bar. Host only, no https://.

secrets.name: S1_API_TOKEN
secrets.description: API token of a SentinelOne service user.

setup:
## SentinelOne side
1. Service user (**Settings > Users > Service Users**) whose role may run *Disconnect from network* (e.g. **IR Team** or **SOC**; **Viewer** cannot), scoped to the Account/Site holding the endpoints.
2. Its API token in the secret `S1_API_TOKEN`, allowed for your console host.

## Case side
The target is the case's `hostname` attribute (custom artifact type `hostname`; the *EDR alerts to case* template adds it). Without it, the newest SentinelOne alert promoted into the case is used (`agentRealtimeInfo.agentComputerName`).

## How it works
- `find`: `GET /web/api/v2.1/agents?computerName__like=<host>&limit=50`.
- `disconnect`: only when exactly one returned agent has that exact computer name (case-insensitive), `POST /web/api/v2.1/agents/actions/disconnect` with `{"filter": {"ids": [<agent id>]}}`. The action is sent by agent id, never by a name filter, so a typo or an ignored filter cannot disconnect other agents.
- A note records the lookup and disconnect statuses and `data.affected`. Reconnect from the console (or `agents/actions/connect`).

To double-check in your console's API doc: the `computerName__like` filter on `GET /agents`.

Docs relied on: the Management API reference is behind the console login (`https://<console>/api-doc/overview`, API v2.1). Public sources used: public open-source SentinelOne API clients (`/web/api/v2.1/` base, `Authorization: ApiToken <token>`, `threats?createdAt__gt=`, `agents/actions/disconnect` with `{"filter": {...}}`) and the PS-SentinelOne module (https://powershellgallery.com/packages/PS-SentinelOne). Double-check against your console's API doc before enabling.

## Containment guardrails
A **containment guard** step runs before the action: targets protected in **Settings → Integrations → Containment guardrails** (VIPs, domain controllers, critical ranges) are never contained automatically, and the tenant's daily and per-case caps apply. A refusal stops the run and adds a case note; every action is listed on the case under **Artifacts & assets → Containment**, where an analyst marks it released once undone.

## Playbook tasks
Run from a case task (a playbook task linked to this workflow), the last step records the outcome on the task and ticks it when the action succeeded; a skipped or failed attempt is recorded and the task stays open. Run any other way, that step does nothing.

config.expression: (case.attributes.get('hostname', '') or ((alert.payload.get('agentRealtimeInfo') or {}).get('agentComputerName') or '' if alert and alert.source == 'sentinelone' and alert.payload is mapping else '')) | length > 0 and (case.attributes.get('hostname', '') or ((alert.payload.get('agentRealtimeInfo') or {}).get('agentComputerName') or '' if alert and alert.source == 'sentinelone' and alert.payload is mapping else '')) | length < 256 and "'" not in (case.attributes.get('hostname', '') or ((alert.payload.get('agentRealtimeInfo') or {}).get('agentComputerName') or '' if alert and alert.source == 'sentinelone' and alert.payload is mapping else '')) and '\\' not in (case.attributes.get('hostname', '') or ((alert.payload.get('agentRealtimeInfo') or {}).get('agentComputerName') or '' if alert and alert.source == 'sentinelone' and alert.payload is mapping else ''))

config.content: SentinelOne disconnect not sent: this case has no hostname. Add a `hostname` artifact and run the workflow again.

config.url: https://%%S1_CONSOLE%%/web/api/v2.1/agents?computerName__like={{ (case.attributes.get('hostname', '') or ((alert.payload.get('agentRealtimeInfo') or {}).get('agentComputerName') or '' if alert and alert.source == 'sentinelone' and alert.payload is mapping else '')) | urlencode }}&limit=50

config.expression: steps.find.output.status == 200 and steps.find.output.body is mapping and ((steps.find.output.body.get('data') or []) | map(attribute='computerName', default='') | map('lower') | select('equalto', (case.attributes.get('hostname', '') or ((alert.payload.get('agentRealtimeInfo') or {}).get('agentComputerName') or '' if alert and alert.source == 'sentinelone' and alert.payload is mapping else '')) | lower) | list | length) == 1

ids: {% for a in steps.find.output.body.data if (a.get('computerName') or '') | lower == (case.attributes.get('hostname', '') or ((alert.payload.get('agentRealtimeInfo') or {}).get('agentComputerName') or '' if alert and alert.source == 'sentinelone' and alert.payload is mapping else '')) | lower %}{{ a.id }}{% endfor %}
